prompt:
You are a senior Odoo 18 functional consultant. A search agent mapped the business requirement below
to candidate Odoo modules. Check its answer.

Requirement (written by a business analyst, may be in Vietnamese or English):
<<<
When opening an invoice, accounting needs to see which stock transfers it covers and which stock moves each invoice line corresponds to.
>>>
English restatement by the search agent: When viewing an invoice, accountants need to see the related stock transfers linked to the overall document as well as the specific stock moves corresponding to each individual invoice line.

Candidate modules, best first. Everything below comes from a knowledge graph built from the installed
Odoo 18 database (models, fields, dependencies) and from the module documentation.

### Candidate 1: stock_picking_invoice_link (OCA module, "Stock Picking Invoice Link")
Direct dependencies: stock_account
Documentation:
# Stock Picking Invoice Link

## SUMMARY
Adds link between pickings and invoices

## DESCRIPTION
The base module used by sale_stock_picking_invoice_link and purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link 
to adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.

## USAGE
- Create a Sales Order and confirm.
- Deliver its pickings totally or partially.
- Create an invoice of the goods delivered.
- If you open invoice form, you must see a new Pickings tab with
  information about them.
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Link stock pickings and invoices: Establishes a link between stock pickings and invoices at both the header and line levels, providing visibility of related pickings in a dedicated tab on the invoice.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.move (Stock Move) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds invoice_line_ids
- stock.picking (Transfer) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds invoice_count, invoice_ids
- account.move.line (Journal Item) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds move_line_ids
- account.move (Journal Entry) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds picking_count, picking_ids
- account.move.reversal (Account Move Reversal) [EXTENDS]
- account.bank.statement.line (Bank Statement Line) [ADDS_FIELD, delegated: no code here]; adds picking_count, picking_ids

### Candidate 2: sale_stock_picking_invoice_link (OCA module, "Stock Picking Invoice Link")
Direct dependencies: sale_stock, stock_picking_invoice_link
Documentation:
# Stock Picking Invoice Link

## SUMMARY
Adds link between pickings and invoices

## DESCRIPTION
This module adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.
Invoices are generated from sales orders. With this module, you can find back
which deliveries an invoice relates to.

In standard, if you make a partial delivery and invoice it, then make remaining
delivery and invoice it, it is impossible to known to what delivery the
invoices relate to. You only have the quantity.

This module is also useful if you want to present data on the invoice report
grouped by deliveries.

Note that the links are only for products with an invoicing policy set on
delivery.

## USAGE
* Create a Sales Order and confirm.
* Deliver its pickings totally or partially.
* Create an invoice of the goods delivered.
* If you open invoice form, you must see a new Pickings tab with information
  about them.
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Link stock pickings and invoices: Establishes links between stock pickings and invoices as well as invoice lines, allowing users to track which deliveries correspond to specific invoices when invoicing sales order items with a delivery invoicing policy.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.move (Stock Move) [EXTENDS]
- sale.order.line (Sales Order Line) [EXTENDS]

### Candidate 3: stock_picking_back2draft (OCA module, "Pickings back to draft")
Direct dependencies: stock
Documentation:
# Pickings back to draft

## SUMMARY
Reopen canceled transfers

## DESCRIPTION
This module allows to bring canceled transfers back to draft

## USAGE
Just open a canceled transfer and click on the 'back to draft' button
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Reopen canceled transfers: Allows users to reset canceled inventory transfers back to the draft state by clicking a button on the canceled picking.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.picking (Transfer) [EXTENDS]
- stock.move (Stock Move) [EXTENDS]
